notes.title: Updated to Ver 1.06e.
notes.content:
Thank you for playing CALAMITY CREATURES.
The game version has been updated to 1.06e.

Updates.

 Game optimisations
 Minor bug fixes.
 Adjusted the difficulty level of chapters 1 and 2.
 Added  Assist Settings.
 Added Theater Mode.
 Added area name display.

Assist Settings
These functions are only available in story mode.
You can adjust the difficulty of the action with damage cut, guard assist and more.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757545/ea73ecbadff9cc0a5c26960a3875a3afc823296a.png

Theater Mode
In theater mode, you can freely browse the novel parts that are interspersed before and after chapters.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757545/d9d9d4fd485a05615430bd1c0bdf0a9c874b95a2.png

Thank you for your continued support of CALAMITY CREATURES in the future.

notes.title: Updated to Ver 1.06c.
notes.content:
Thank you for playing CALAMITY CREATURES.
The game version has been updated to 1.06c.

Bug fixes.

 Fixed inability to progress under certain conditions.
 Fixed Incomplete BGM volume adjustment.
 Fixed differences in lighting depending on the player's state.


Adjustments.

 [Chapter2] Preliminary actions for some attacks have been made easier to understand.
 [Chapter2] Power of some attacks has been revised downwards.
 [Chapter2] Added some strategy tips.
 [Chapter2] Adjusted the position and visibility of the scaffolding at the end of the chapter.
 [Chapter2] Increased the downtime of targets. (If you grab it early, it will return earlier).


Overall, this is an adjustment to make Chapter 2 easier to play.
It is also meant to widen the scope of the game, but also to differentiate it from the hard mode that will be added later on.

Thank you for your continued support of CALAMITY CREATURES in the future.

notes.title: Updated to Ver 1.06b.
notes.content:
Thank you for playing CALAMITY CREATURES.
Sorry for the streak, but I have updated the game version to 1.06b due to a bug I wanted to fix earlier.

Bug fixes.

 Fixed inappropriate acceleration acting on the player outside of inertia.
 Fixed localisation omissions in some text.


Adjustments.

 UI directional controls can now also be performed with the left stick.
 The stick input dead zone has been slightly widened accordingly to prevent misoperation.
 Improved the operation of the right stick aiming.


Thank you for your continued support of CALAMITY CREATURES in the future.
Also, because a rating is displayed with a review count of 10 or more,
If you feel that you would like to continue to play, even just a little bit, I would be happy if you could add a review.

Insight Vision
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42757545/944a3d179a9e3ed2d9afe799836520bfaa446b6d.png

notes.title: Updated to Ver 1.05a.
notes.content:
Thank you for playing CALAMITY CREATURES.
I have made some adjustments based on your review and other feedback.

Updates.

 Added outlines to make it easier for player character to see.
 Increased the grip on some gimmicks, such as bolts and levers.
 Adjusted the starting position of Chapter 1.
 A shortcut to the boss area now appears at the starting point if Chapter 2 has already been cleared.


I are also planning to implement a function to make it easier to understand where you can grab and ride" in the future.
If you have any other bugs or concerns, I would appreciate it if you could report them in a review or on the forum.
